verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents its own Postgres endpoint aimed at "BI tools, any Postgres client", plus official drivers and SDKs including Java. That gives analysts a standard-protocol path to connect dashboards without custom glue. However, the evidence never names JDBC or ODBC drivers or any specific BI tool with a setup guide, so the depth of the integration is unproven. Missing for 10: explicitly documented JDBC/ODBC drivers, named BI-tool integration guides (e.g. Tableau/Power BI/Looker), independent or hands-on corroboration of dashboards connecting.

support.subject: As an analyst, standard drivers (JDBC/ODBC) and documented BI-tool integrations connect my dashboards without custom glue

citations.quote: Postgres endpoint: BI tools, any Postgres client - Use any Postgres-compatible tool, no DuckDB install needed
Connect to MotherDuck using official drivers and APIs for various programming languages.
DuckDB SDKs: Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R, Java
